decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to focus on actual speakers rather than accessories like cases and chargers. My consideration set includes a range of options: a budget portable speaker (FLYSH), a high-end room-filling unit (Sony), a rugged outdoor option (Monster), and two mid-range powerhouses (NOTABRICK and BOGASING). I ultimately chose the NOTABRICK speaker because it offers the best balance of features (20W, IPX7 waterproof) and highly consistent customer satisfaction (4.6 rating) at a reasonable mid-market price point.
